verdict.rationale: Font rendering is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, but nothing in the evidence pack covers ligature support, fallback fonts, or font tuning. The closest items are generic: a broad claim of many configuration options and Unicode/emoji internationalization support. Neither documents the font capabilities this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use programming fonts with ligatures, fallback fonts, and fine-grained font tuning
